description: Engine-free Armenia v1 target references. Observed quantities live only in the future ledger-am fact package. Calibration rows map exclusively to direct donor columns or deterministic prepared indicators; national-accounts rows are validation-only. Survey-measured poverty and tax-benefit quantities are permanent holdouts and are intentionally absent.

target_references.name: armstat_population_by_age_sex_marz
target_references.notes: Primary age x sex x marz margin from the Statbank PxWeb endpoint. The release profile projects the 2022-census-vintage series to 2024 in Ledger; the package carries no level.

target_references.name: armstat_ilcs_households_by_size_marz
target_references.notes: Raw household structure derived from the public ILCS household file with official weights. Exact variable codes and current sample size are harvest items.

target_references.name: armstat_ilcs_households_by_consumption_band_marz
target_references.notes: Consumption is ArmStat's official welfare measure. Fit household counts across reviewed consumption bands, not the survey's poverty classifications or a survey-derived tax-benefit quantity.

target_references.name: armstat_ilcs_households_by_income_band_marz
target_references.notes: ILCS income is underreported and seasonal, so this raw-income distribution starts diagnostic and may not displace the consumption welfare margin.

target_references.name: armstat_lfs_employed_by_age_sex_marz
target_references.notes: Raw employment-status counts derived from the public 2024 LFS member microdata. The exact questionnaire codes and weighting fields are harvest items.

target_references.name: armstat_lfs_employees_by_industry_sex_marz
target_references.notes: Employee counts by direct labour-status and industry columns; no Armenian tax or benefit engine output is involved.

target_references.name: armstat_src_payroll_employees_by_industry_sex_marz
target_references.notes: Administrative payroll-employee counts from the SRC-register series published by ArmStat. Harvest the exact one of the nine published datasets and its dimensions.

target_references.name: armstat_src_payroll_wages_by_industry_sex_marz
target_references.notes: Administrative wage amount against the donor's direct employment-income column. Ledger must reconcile monthly versus annual basis before activation.

target_references.name: armstat_average_monthly_nominal_wage
target_references.notes: The supplied 2024 mean is a cross-check. Do not activate it alongside the component payroll table as a duplicate total; Chronicle must pair it with a compatible employee count and period basis.

target_references.name: armstat_pensioner_caseload
target_references.notes: Harvest a current 2024 caseload. The supplied January 2022 count is stale evidence only and must not silently populate this reference.

target_references.name: armstat_pension_payment_total
target_references.notes: Chronicle must combine same-vintage caseload and mean facts. The supplied January 2022 count and December 2023 mean may not be multiplied across periods.

target_references.name: armstat_family_social_benefit_families
target_references.notes: Current caseload for the ArmStat series 'Number of families receiving family and social benefits'. Benefit-rule amounts and eligibility are not used in engine-free v1.

target_references.name: armstat_sna_household_consumption
target_references.notes: Macro-realism denominator only, never a hard calibration row. The survey-to-SNA concept bridge is analyst work and the known survey coverage gap must remain visible.

target_references.name: armstat_sna_household_disposable_income
target_references.notes: Macro-realism denominator only. The donor's direct household-income aggregate is a documented bridge, not an assertion that survey and SNA concepts are identical.
